messages:
jamal: pushing metadata-sync v2 canary to ap-southeast1 (3 nodes). reduces lock contention but fans writes.
anna: if nvme iops go bonkers pause please — last deploy caused gpu-attach waits
jamal: watching. baseline nvme write ops ~11.8k/s per node
sre-bot: ALERT ap-southeast1 nvme_write_ops 44k/s (5m) · p95 latency 92ms · impacted: scratchpool
lucy: gpu attach queue spiked, ~130 pending
jamal: halting canary, toggled rollout flag @3309876543
marco: stack trace points to sync worker fsync hotspots
marco: ```
writer.go:210 flushBatch(256) -> sync() -> syscall.fsync
writer.go:267 retry on EAGAIN
```
anna: SMART shows write bytes and write amplification increasing — could be batching bug
ops-jen: temp mitigation: drop FANOUT_THREADS 6->2 and enable per-node nvme throttle
jamal: applied env change: `kubectl -n infra set env deploy/meta-sync FANOUT_THREADS=2 NVME_THROTTLE=9000`
sre-bot: rollout completed to 3/3 canary pods
lucy: attach queue down to 35, attach latencies improving
marco: visibility query:
marco: ```promql
sum(rate(nvme_write_ops_total[1m])) by (region)
```
marco: shows ap-southeast1 jumped 12k -> 48k after fanout
anna: long term options: increase batch size to reduce fsync frequency, or offload metadata to compact replicated SSDs/network store
jamal: offload tradeoffs: network hop per attach adds latency and egress cost but preserves local nvme health
ops-jen: rough cost add ~0.07 $/gpu-hr if we spin extra metadata proxies in-region
lucy: short-term: create 25% headroom by tightening scratchpool auto-provision thresholds
marco: propose safety circuit: if nvme_write_ops > 30k for 90s then auto-divert new gpu attaches to fallback region (us-west)
anna: please automate diversion; paging at 3am is painful
jamal: will open PR for diversion + runbook, tagging oncall
ops-jen: provisioning 8-node spare pool in us-west to accept diverted attaches (budget: infra-emerg)
lucy: SLO impact quick calc: median attach +18ms during diversion but avoids attach failures
sre-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-348 created · owner: jamal · sev: high
anna: next steps: jamal PR for diversion + batching redesign, marco profile writer codepath, ops-jen provision fallback, lucy SLO delta
jamal: will log a concise postmortem to #postmortems once stabilized. keeping rollback until batching fix ships
anna: :thumbsup: ping if throttle causes replication queue pileup
